fields.statement: At 89df6c69e (fixer commit: unlandable servers keep no milestone open) ran go test -trimpath -count=1 ./tools/release/... -run 'TestNextVersion|TestMilestone' -v: TestNextVersion, TestNextVersionFromLogs and the new TestMilestoneIgnoresUnlandableServers pass; go vet clean. Read the diff: ReadHistory now skips serves from change sets whose withdraw/reject/supersede entries end them (entry type names match internal/entry TypeWithdraw/TypeReject/TypeSupersede; reopen only follows a landing per the lifecycle table), serves links retired by link.retire (unless the retire op is dropped) and link.create ops a body.drop retracts; op field names id/link/drop match real log entries. go run ./tools/release check on this repo's log reports v0.2.0 minor since v0.1.0 (pre-v1 breaking is minor) with milestone-32 finished.
